_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Data_ExtraDialogue.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

Birdie0.chinese: 孩子，我从来没想过还能在岛上看见新面孔。你能来这里我很高兴！
Birdie0.english: Child, I never thought I could still see a new face on the island. I'm very glad you could come here!

Birdie1.chinese: 传说在很久以前，岛上存在着发达的矮人文明。#$e#你去过火山里面吗？到处都是矮人造出的奇怪机器的残骸……
Birdie1.english: Legend says long ago, a developed dwarf civilisation existed on the island. Have you been inside the volcano? Everywhere are the remains of strange machines the dwarves made...

Birdie12.chinese: 唉……在这个可能性无限的世界里，我们永远无法知道自己是否做出了正确的选择。$s#$b#很抱歉打扰到你了，孩子。有时候我会迷失在自己的想法之中……
Birdie12.english: Sigh... in this world of limitless possibility, we can never know whether we made the right choice. Very sorry to disturb you, child. Sometimes I get lost in my own thoughts...

Birdie15.chinese: 水果、鱼、采集到的食物……吃得真不错！我感觉跟以前一样健康。
Birdie15.english: Fruit, fish, foraged food... eating really well! I feel as healthy as before.

Birdie17.chinese: 孩子，这里的气候全年温暖宜人……很适合我这把老骨头……
Birdie17.english: Child, the climate here is warm and pleasant all year... very suitable for these old bones of mine...

Birdie19.chinese: 你在雨林里见过那个小小的香蕉祭坛吗？要是我拿到一根香蕉，我会把它摆上去看看会发生什么……呵呵……$h
Birdie19.english: Have you seen that little banana altar in the rainforest? If I got a banana, I'd put it up there and see what happens... heh heh...

Birdie2.chinese: 如果你感觉胃不舒服，吃一口姜会有奇效，孩子……
Birdie2.english: If you feel your stomach is unwell, eating a bite of ginger works wonders, child...

Birdie22.chinese: 你好，孩子……看起来你今天很健康，心情也不错！$h
Birdie22.english: Hello, child... you look very healthy today, and in a good mood too!

Birdie23.chinese: 在这里待了太久，我已经听不到海浪声了……
Birdie23.english: Having stayed here too long, I already can't hear the sound of the waves...

Birdie28.chinese: 今晚是满月……孩子，不管你的运气是好是坏，提高警惕……鬼魂们躁动不安。
Birdie28.english: Tonight is a full moon... child, whether your luck is good or bad, be on alert... the ghosts are restless.

Birdie3.chinese: 你去过雨林里的秘密神庙吗？那里的花闻起来很香……那是我在岛上最喜欢的地方之一。$h
Birdie3.english: Have you been to the secret temple in the rainforest? The flowers there smell very fragrant... that is one of my favourite places on the island.

Birdie4.chinese: 我每天早上的早餐是一碗芋泥和一杯鲜榨芒果汁。这是我保持年轻的秘诀！
Birdie4.english: Every morning my breakfast is a bowl of taro paste and a glass of freshly squeezed mango juice. This is my secret to staying young!

Birdie5.chinese: 我每天都在海滩上散步，看看有没有新东西冲上岸来。海面上可是漂浮着很多东西！
Birdie5.english: Every day I walk on the beach, to see if any new things washed up on shore. On the sea there are a lot of things floating!

Birdie6.chinese: 我的屋子可能是小了点，但对我来说已经足够了。它是我造的，就是最好的。
Birdie6.english: My house may be a bit small, but for me it's already enough. I built it, so it's the best.

Birdie_NoGift.chinese: 啊，不不不……我不需要任何礼物，孩子。你留着就好。
Birdie_NoGift.english: Ah, no no no... I don't need any gift, child. Just keep it.

Clint_NoInventorySpace.chinese: 嘿。你的工具准备好了，但你的物品栏满了。
Clint_NoInventorySpace.english: Hey. Your tool is ready, but your inventory is full.

Clint_StillWorking.chinese: 嗯，我还在做你的{0}。今天是做不好了。
Clint_StillWorking.english: Mm, I'm still working on your {0}. Today it won't get done.

Farm_RobinWorking1.chinese: 你的新{0}将在 {1} 天内完工。假装我不在这里。
Farm_RobinWorking1.english: Your new {0} will be finished within {1} days. Pretend I'm not here.

Farm_RobinWorking2.chinese: 你的新{0}将在 {1} 天内完工。我将夜以继日的扑在这件事上！
Farm_RobinWorking2.english: Your new {0} will be finished within {1} days. I'll throw myself into this day and night!

Farm_RobinWorking_ReadyTomorrow.chinese: 你的新房子{0}明天完成！你兴奋吗？
Farm_RobinWorking_ReadyTomorrow.english: Your new house {0} finishes tomorrow! Are you excited?

Gunther_MuseumComplete.chinese: 博物馆看起来太棒啦！再次感谢你的帮助。
Gunther_MuseumComplete.english: The museum looks so great! Thanks again for your help.

Gunther_NoArtifactsFound.chinese: 你好啊！欢迎来到星露谷考古研究办公室。#$b#啊……说起来怪丢人的，不过上一任馆长把所有的藏品都卷走了。我们什么可展示的工艺品也没有了。#$b#不过我希望这一点能很快得到改善！嘿，如果你在外面找到什么工艺品啊矿石啊之类的，能不能告诉我一声呢？
Gunther_NoArtifactsFound.english: Hello! Welcome to the Stardew Valley Archaeology Research Office. Ah... speaking of it is rather embarrassing, but the previous curator made off with all the collection. We have no artifacts we can display. But I hope this can improve soon! Hey, if you find any artifacts or ores or the like out there, could you tell me?

Gunther_NothingToDonate.chinese: 你似乎没有要捐给博物馆的。最好出去寻宝，哈？
Gunther_NothingToDonate.english: You seem to have nothing to donate to the museum. Best go out treasure hunting, huh?

Island_leo_rescue.chinese: 看来你还活着。$u#$b#我的鸟儿朋友们发现了你，告诉我你有危险，所以我拖着你把你带到了这里。$s#$b#在外面还请多注意安全。我不想再伤心一次了……$s
Island_leo_rescue.english: Looks like you're still alive. My bird friends found you and told me you were in danger, so I dragged you and brought you here. Please be careful about safety out there. I don't want to be sad again...

Island_willy_rescue.chinese: 小伙子你没事吧？你被冲到了岸上，是我找到你的。$s^小姑娘你没事吧？你被冲到了岸上，是我找到你的。$s#$b#我太担心了……我以为你快没气了！在外面要小心一点啊……$s#$b#这个岛屿可不是到处都安全的。
Island_willy_rescue.english: Young man (/ young lady), are you all right? You were washed up on the shore, and it was me who found you. I was so worried... I thought you were almost out of breath! Be a little careful out there... This island is certainly not safe everywhere.

Mines_PlayerKilled_Clint.chinese: ……我发现你在矿山不省人事。我以为我当时要累死了，一路上把你拖到这儿来！#$b#下次小心一点，好吗？$s
Mines_PlayerKilled_Clint.english: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. I thought I was going to be exhausted to death, dragging you all the way here! Be a little careful next time, okay?

Mines_PlayerKilled_Linus.chinese: ……我发现你在矿山不省人事。你很幸运，我刚巧路过！#$b#下次小心点，好吗？$s
Mines_PlayerKilled_Linus.english: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. You're very lucky I happened to pass by! Be a bit careful next time, okay?

Mines_PlayerKilled_Maru_NotSpouse.chinese: ……我发现你在矿山不省人事。我当时正在寻找矿产，差点踩在你头上！#$b#下次小心点，好吗？$s
Mines_PlayerKilled_Maru_NotSpouse.english: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. I was looking for minerals at the time and nearly stepped on your head! Be a bit careful next time, okay?

Mines_PlayerKilled_Maru_Spouse.chinese: ……我发现你在矿山不省人事。你去了那么长时间，我开始担心起你来！#$b#下次小心点，好吗？$s
Mines_PlayerKilled_Maru_Spouse.english: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. You were gone such a long time, I began to worry about you! Be a bit careful next time, okay?

Mines_PlayerKilled_Robin.chinese: ……我发现你在矿山不省人事。我几乎把你错认为是一块热带木！#$b#下次，更加小心一点，好吗？$s
Mines_PlayerKilled_Robin.english: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. I almost mistook you for a piece of tropical wood! Next time, be a bit more careful, okay?

Mines_PlayerKilled_Spouse_PlayerFemale.chinese: 你已经去了那么长时间，我不由得担心起你来！当我看到你柔弱的身体时，我差点发心脏病……$a
Mines_PlayerKilled_Spouse_PlayerFemale.english: You'd been gone so long, I couldn't help worrying about you! When I saw your limp body, I nearly had a heart attack...

Mines_PlayerKilled_Spouse_PlayerMale.chinese: 你已经去了那么长时间，我不由得担心起你来！当我看到你柔弱的身体时，我哭了起来……$s
Mines_PlayerKilled_Spouse_PlayerMale.english: You'd been gone so long, I couldn't help worrying about you! When I saw your limp body, I started crying...

MisterQi_PlayerClubMember.chinese: 终于见到你了，孩子，真好啊。欢迎来到我的专属会所。#$e#你已经得到了“火花”……这就是为什么我挑中了你。#$e#什么火花？啊……就是通往神奇彼岸，通往艺术的通道……#$b#像我们这样的人有责任让世界保持活力，给乡亲们非凡的味道。#$e#明白吗，小子……这个世界就像一碗饭。它有食材，但是如果没有好的、刺激的酱料，便索然无味。这就是为什么这个地方会存在。#$b#你难道不想知道是谁把那些宝箱放在老矿井里？我喜欢给人们惊喜。#$e#总有一天你会明白的。尽力做到最好，永不放弃。
MisterQi_PlayerClubMember.english: Finally meeting you, kid, really good. Welcome to my exclusive club. You've already got the "spark"... that's why I picked you. What spark? Ah... it's the passage leading to the marvellous other shore, leading to art... People like us have a duty to keep the world lively, to give the folks an extraordinary flavour. Understand, kid... this world is like a bowl of rice. It has ingredients, but without a good, zesty sauce, it's flavourless. That's why this place exists. Didn't you want to know who put those treasure chests in the old mine? I like to give people surprises. Some day you'll understand. Do your best, never give up.

Morris_BuyMovieTheater.chinese: 啊，我们最喜欢的顾客……我有激动人心的消息要告诉你！Joja 总部已经批准拆掉附近的Joja仓库，在那里建造一个新的 Joja “娱乐机会”。我们只需要一个愿意支持我们愿景的投资者！于是，我很自然地找到了您……我们最热诚慷慨的 Joja 会员。#$b#$q -1 -1#我们只需要……咳咳……500,000 金的小额投资……就能实现它。$h#$r -1 -1 Yes#是#$r -1 -1 No#否
Morris_BuyMovieTheater.english: Ah, our favourite customer... I have exciting news to tell you! Joja headquarters has already approved tearing down the nearby Joja warehouse, and building a new Joja "entertainment opportunity" there. We just need an investor willing to support our vision! So, very naturally, I found you... our most ardent and generous Joja member. We only need... ahem... a small investment of 500,000 gold... to make it happen. Yes / No

Morris_ComeBackLater.chinese: 明天再来，我们就开始着手社区整治……记得带上钱啊。呵呵。
Morris_ComeBackLater.english: Come again tomorrow, and we'll start setting about community improvement... remember to bring money. Hehe.

Morris_CommunityDevelopmentForm_PlayerFe.chinese: $q -1 -1#小姐，我为您拿到了 Joja 社区发展申请书。要看看吗？#$r -1 -1 Yes#是#$r -1 -1 No#否
Morris_CommunityDevelopmentForm_PlayerFe.english: Miss, I've got the Joja Community Development application for you. Want to take a look? Yes / No

Morris_CommunityDevelopmentForm_PlayerMa.chinese: $q -1 -1#先生，我为您拿到了 Joja 社区发展申请书。要看看吗？#$r -1 -1 Yes#是#$r -1 -1 No#否
Morris_CommunityDevelopmentForm_PlayerMa.english: Sir, I've got the Joja Community Development application for you. Want to take a look? Yes / No

Morris_FirstGreeting.chinese: 欢迎来到 Joja 超市！今天过得怎么样？#$b#我们目前正在为客户建立一个全新的会员制。请稍后访问并加入我们！
Morris_FirstGreeting.english: Welcome to Joja Supermarket! How is today going? We are currently setting up a brand-new membership system for customers. Please visit later and join us!

Morris_FirstGreeting_CommunityCenterComp.chinese: 欢迎来到 Joja 超市！您今天过得怎么样？#$b#很遗憾，由于意外情况，我们的 Joja 会员优惠目前无法提供。我相信很快就会解决的！
Morris_FirstGreeting_CommunityCenterComp.english: Welcome to Joja supermarket! How are you passing today? Very regrettably, due to unexpected circumstances, our Joja membership offer currently cannot be provided. I believe it will be resolved very soon!

Morris_FirstGreeting_MembershipAvailable.chinese: 欢迎来到 Joja 超市！今天过得怎么样？#$b#会员资格现已上市！成为 Joja 会员，在专职人员的帮助下，您将能够付费改进社区……当然。#$b#啊，还有另一件事……镇长刘易斯向我们承诺，如果其他任何人加入了，就让我们把旧的社区中心变成 Joja 仓库。那不是好极了？#$q -1 -1#会员费用 {0} 金。那么，你愿意加入我们吗？#$r -1 -1 Yes#愿意。#$r -1 -1 No#不愿意。
Morris_FirstGreeting_MembershipAvailable.english: Welcome to Joja supermarket! How is today passing? Membership qualification is now on the market! Becoming a Joja member, with the help of dedicated staff, you will be able to pay to improve the community... of course. Ah, there is also another matter... Mayor Lewis promised us that if anyone else joined, he'd let us turn the old community center into a Joja warehouse. Isn't that wonderful? Membership costs {0} gold. So, are you willing to join us? Willing. Not willing.

Morris_FirstGreeting_SecondPlayer.chinese: 欢迎来到 Joja 超市！今天过得怎么样？#$b#嗯……我们的记录显示，你与其他人住在一个农场……我很抱歉，但是我们只能向您住所的业主出售会员资格。
Morris_FirstGreeting_SecondPlayer.english: Welcome to Joja supermarket! How is today passing? Hmm... our records show you live on one farm with other people... I'm very sorry, but we can only sell membership qualification to the owner of your residence.

Morris_Greeting.chinese: 欢迎来到 Joja 超市！今天感觉如何啊？#$b#我们似乎是第一次见面。我叫莫里斯，是Joja的顾客满意度代表。#$b#当你想要成为Joja成员时，我很乐意帮助你轻松地适应这里。
Morris_Greeting.english: Welcome to Joja supermarket! How do you feel today? We seem to be meeting for the first time. I'm called Morris, Joja's customer satisfaction representative. When you want to become a Joja member, I'll be very glad to help you easily adapt to here.

Morris_JojaCDConfirm.chinese: 太棒了！今晚我们将招聘工人。明天会为你准备好。
Morris_JojaCDConfirm.english: Great! Tonight we'll recruit workers. Tomorrow it will be ready for you.

Morris_NoMoreCD.chinese: 啊！我最喜欢的顾客……可惜的是，我目前没有更多的社区发展项目了。
Morris_NoMoreCD.english: Ah! My favorite customer... Regrettably, I currently have no more community development projects.

Morris_PlayerSignedUp.chinese: 太棒了！欢迎来到 Joja 公司！明天再来吧，我们就可以开始着手社区整治了……哦，别忘了带上钱包！呵呵。#$b#现在，我来打个电话给镇长刘易斯，看看脏乱的老社区中心要怎么弄……
Morris_PlayerSignedUp.english: Great! Welcome to Joja Corporation! Come again tomorrow, and we can start setting about community improvement... oh, don't forget to bring your wallet! Hehe. Now, let me make a phone call to Mayor Lewis, and see what to do about the dirty, messy old community center...

Morris_StillProcessingOrder.chinese: 目前，我们正处理您的最后一个社区发展需求。请完工后回来。
Morris_StillProcessingOrder.english: Currently, we are processing your last community development request. Please come back after completion.

Morris_TheaterBought.chinese: 五十万……！$2#$b#咳……我是说……太好了！我们的 Joja 施工队今晚将开始新大楼的施工！感谢您对我们的工作的支持。
Morris_TheaterBought.english: Five hundred thousand...! Ahem... I mean... too good! Our Joja construction team will begin construction of the new building tonight! Thank you for your support of our work.

Morris_WeekendGreeting.chinese: 欢迎来到 Joja 超市！周末过得怎么样？#$b#我们目前正在为客户建立一个全新的会员制。请稍后访问并加入我们！

NewChild_Adoption.chinese: 小家伙走进我们的生活{0}真是太好了！
NewChild_Adoption.english: Little guy {0} walking into our life is really too good!

NewChild_FirstChild.chinese: 一切都很好，现在{0}小家伙是家里的一份子。我们真幸运。
NewChild_FirstChild.english: Everything is very good; now little {0} is a part of the family. We are really lucky.

NewChild_SecondChild1.chinese: 看看我们的小窝……我们有了很大的进展，对吧？
NewChild_SecondChild1.english: Look at our little nest... we have made great progress, right?

NewChild_SecondChild2.chinese: 两个漂亮的小孩……我们有了很大的进展，对吧？
NewChild_SecondChild2.english: Two beautiful little kids... we have made great progress, right?

ProfessorSnail_Hint_820.chinese: 你在岛上找到过金椰子吗？有传闻说，金椰子里有许多不错的东西……
ProfessorSnail_Hint_820.english: Have you found golden coconuts on the island? There are rumors that inside golden coconuts there are many good things...

ProfessorSnail_Hint_821.chinese: 其实，岛上有许多优质的钓鱼地点。据我所知，许多鱼都喜欢咬古老的骨头……
ProfessorSnail_Hint_821.english: Actually, there are many high-quality fishing spots on the island. As far as I know, many fish like to bite old bones...

ProfessorSnail_Hint_822.chinese: 要我说，如果你用淘盘在附近的河里捞一捞，一定能发现些有意思的东西。
ProfessorSnail_Hint_822.english: If you ask me, if you use a pan to scoop around in the nearby river, you'll surely discover some interesting things.

ProfessorSnail_Hint_824.chinese: 我被困在洞穴里之前，在探索洞穴附近的一处小溪谷。那里的石头全都是化石！我建议你把它们敲开，在里面找找有没有骨头。
ProfessorSnail_Hint_824.english: Before I was trapped in the cave, I was exploring a small valley near the cave. The stones there are all fossils! I suggest you knock them open, and look inside for whether there are bones.

ProfessorSnail_Hint_825.chinese: 你要是看到土地里有什么东西在蠕动，别忘了把它挖出来看看。你永远猜不到地里究竟藏着什么的！
ProfessorSnail_Hint_825.english: If you see something wriggling in the ground, don't forget to dig it out and look. You'll never guess what exactly is hidden in the ground!

ProfessorSnail_Hint_826.chinese: 嗯……我能闻出来，这段蛇脊骨应该来自于岛的西侧。
ProfessorSnail_Hint_826.english: Hmm... I can smell it out, this segment of snake spine should come from the west side of the island.

ProfessorSnail_Hint_827.chinese: 很久以前，一种罕见的洞穴蝙蝠栖息在这里。有证据表明它们能够耐受高温。很有趣对吧？
ProfessorSnail_Hint_827.english: Long ago, a rare kind of cave bat lived here. There is evidence showing they could endure high temperatures. Very interesting, right?

SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Leah.english: I think we've all found what we wanted here. Besides being together with you here and now, I have nothing else to ask for.

SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Maru.chinese: @，你自从搬到这里之后，真的做出了不少成就。实在是太了不起了。"/pause 300/faceDirection Maru 3/pause 400/speak Maru "我想，你应该生来就是当农场主的料！$h"
SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Maru.english: @, since you moved here, you really have achieved quite a lot. It's really so amazing. I think you must have been born to be a farmer!

SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Penny.chinese: 我们有漂亮的房子，有欣欣向荣的家……这已经超出我所梦想的一切了。$l
SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Penny.english: We have a pretty house, a thriving family... this already exceeds everything I dreamed of.

SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Sam.chinese: 自从我们相遇以来，我改变了许多……你感觉到了吗？#$b#……你可能会说我“变成熟了”……嘿嘿。$10#$b#但是在此时此地，我更加期待我们共同的未来……$l#$b#哪怕只是做些稀松平常的事情，像是……呃……采购日用品和换尿布……哈……$10
SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Sam.english: Since we met, I've changed a lot... can you feel it? ...You could say I've "matured"... hehe. But here and now, I'm looking forward even more to our shared future... Even just doing ordinary things, like... uh... buying groceries and changing diapers... ha...

SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Sebastian.chinese: 在遇到你之前，我把自己的人生都耗费在逃避现实上……因为我觉得自己永远都得不到幸福。#$b#……但你向我证明，世界并不只是一片黑暗。$h"/faceDirection Sebastian 3/pause 500/speak Sebastian "……我有许多爱你的理由，这是其中之一……"
SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Sebastian.english: Before meeting you, I spent my whole life escaping reality... because I thought I would never get happiness. ...But you proved to me that the world isn't just a stretch of darkness. ...I have many reasons for loving you; this is one of them...

SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Shane.chinese: @，要是我没有遇见你……恐怕我就不会到这里来了。#$b#那就太可惜了，毕竟这里是绝无仅有的观鸟点！$h"/emote farmer 16/pause 1000/speak Shane "……我……我经常开玩笑，因为……呃……$s#$b#我觉得，只要把所有事情都一笑置之，我就不用敞开心扉，让自己变得脆弱了。"/emote Shane 28/speak Shane "但与你在一起，每度过一个季节，我都会变得更加安然自在一些。#$b#呃……我想说的大概就是……#$b#和你结婚我无怨无悔！$h"
SummitEvent_Dialogue3_Shane.english: @, if I hadn't met you... I'm afraid I wouldn't have come here. That would be too bad, after all this is a one-of-a-kind birdwatching spot! ...I... I joke a lot, because... uh... I felt that as long as I laughed everything off, I wouldn't have to open up my heart and let myself become vulnerable. But being with you, with every season that passes, I become a bit more at ease. Uh... what I want to say is probably... I have no regrets marrying you!

SummitEvent_Intro_Morris.chinese: 啊，@……我最喜欢的 Joja 会员。

SummitEvent_Outro_Lewis.chinese: @，也许你没有感觉到，我非常关心这个镇子。#$b#%year 年前，我非常担心星露谷的未来。$s#$b#但现在我彻底放心了。#$b#谁又能想到，一位移居而来的普通农场主能够带来翻天覆地的变化呢？$h#$b#……谢谢你。
SummitEvent_Outro_Lewis.english: @, maybe you didn't feel it, but I care a great deal about this town. (Year) years ago, I was very worried about Stardew Valley's future. But now I'm completely at ease. Who could have imagined that an ordinary farmer who moved here could bring such earth-shaking change? ...Thank you.

SummitEvent_Outro_Morris.chinese: @，我只想说……非常感激你为 Joja 公司做的一切。#$b#我们仰仗着我们的会员才得以强大，而你展现出了教科书般的积极性与机巧。所以，我才会因为供职于这间公司而自豪。$h
SummitEvent_Outro_Morris.english: @, I just want to say... I'm very grateful for everything you've done for the Joja company. We rely on our members to be strong, and you displayed textbook-like enthusiasm and ingenuity. So that's why I'm proud to work for this company.

SummitEvent_closingmessage.english: This is a long, long road...

SummitEvent_closingmessage2.chinese: 你挑战自己，登上了顶峰。
SummitEvent_closingmessage2.english: You challenged yourself and climbed to the summit.

SummitEvent_closingmessage4.chinese: 我们见证了你征途中的每一步……
SummitEvent_closingmessage4.english: We witnessed every step of your journey...

SummitEvent_closingmessage5.chinese: 我们为你感到无比自豪！
SummitEvent_closingmessage5.english: We feel incomparably proud of you!

Town_DumpsterDiveComment_Adult.english: Hey, don't touch that garbage! ...It's dirty!

Town_DumpsterDiveComment_Teen.chinese: 呃……你在垃圾堆里面翻什么呢？$s
Town_DumpsterDiveComment_Teen.english: Uh... what are you rummaging for in the garbage heap?

Wizard_Hatch.chinese: 你正在做什么？我只允许我信任的那些人进来这里。
Wizard_Hatch.english: What are you doing? I only allow those people I trust to come in here.

SkullCavern_100_event#0.english: Well, well, well... you made it.

SkullCavern_100_event#1.chinese: 走近一些，马上……不要害羞。
SkullCavern_100_event#1.english: Come a bit closer, right now... don't be shy.

SkullCavern_100_event#2.chinese: 我听说你今天正试图潜入这些洞穴……#$b#我必须亲眼看看！
SkullCavern_100_event#2.english: I heard that today you were trying to dive into these caves... I had to see it with my own eyes!

SkullCavern_100_event#3.chinese: 真开眼界……太开眼界了。一路下来，是多么伟大的一个成就啊！#$b#……尽管你通过制作楼梯，跳过了一堆关卡。聪明，当然……但不是很光荣。$1#$b#即便如此，对于我来说，要挖掘那么石头，也是一项大工程。这种专注是值得称赞的。你是件宝贝，孩子。
SkullCavern_100_event#3.english: Truly eye-opening... so eye-opening. Coming all the way down, what a great achievement! ...Although you skipped a bunch of levels by making staircases. Clever, of course... but not very honorable. Even so, for me, digging through that much stone is also a big undertaking. This kind of focus is worthy of praise. You're a treasure, kid.

SkullCavern_100_event#4.chinese: 现在……去桌边，喝下我给你准备这杯特殊奶汁。
SkullCavern_100_event#4.english: Now... go to the table and drink this special milk I prepared for you.

SkullCavern_100_event#5.chinese: 这叫作“铱蛇牛奶”……喝一小口，你就会变得更加强大。
SkullCavern_100_event#5.english: This is called "Iridium Snake Milk"... take one small sip and you'll become stronger.

SkullCavern_100_event#6.chinese: 味道很糟糕，口感则更差。
SkullCavern_100_event#6.english: The taste is terrible, and the texture is even worse.

SkullCavern_100_event#7.chinese: ……但你的健康值却永久增加了 25！
SkullCavern_100_event#7.english: ...But your health has permanently increased by 25!

SkullCavern_100_event#8.english: Kid, wish you good luck down there.

SkullCavern_100_event_honorable#0.english: Well, well, well... you made it.

SkullCavern_100_event_honorable#1.english: Come a bit closer, right now... don't be shy.

SkullCavern_100_event_honorable#2.english: I heard that today you were trying to dive into these caves... I had to see it with my own eyes!

SkullCavern_100_event_honorable#3.chinese: 真开眼界……太开眼界了。孩子，你出色地通过了我的考验。#$b#我十分高兴地见到，你挑战自我，一路荣耀走来，没有通过制作楼梯跳过任何关卡。#$b#这表明你是真材实料，孩子。你有原则。#$b#你明白挑战自己的重要性，即使没有人注意，也要坚持自己的最高标准。#$b#这就是为什么你很特别，孩子……明白吗？你以身作则。我欣赏这点。
SkullCavern_100_event_honorable#3.english: Truly eye-opening... so eye-opening. Kid, you passed my test outstandingly. I'm very happy to see that you challenged yourself and came all the way honorably, without skipping any levels by making staircases. This shows you're the real deal, kid. You have principles. You understand the importance of challenging yourself, and of holding to your own highest standard even when nobody is watching. That's why you're special, kid... understand? You lead by example. I appreciate that.
